t: You're on Jermyn Street, outside Tramp, a private members club in central London. It opened in 1969, founded by Johnny Gold, Bill Ofner and Oscar Lerman. Gold had come to London in the mid 1950s, and Lerman hired him to run a nightclub called Dolly's. He thought Tramp might last only two or three years, but it became popular with celebrities. He sold his stake in 1998, then stayed on until 2003 as greeter-in-chief.
